description: Lockheed Martin ODIN / UK MOD Form 707A Aircraft Maintenance Log Work Orders across RAF Marham (617 Sqn, 207 Sqn), HMS Queen Elizabeth (809 NAS), and HMS Prince of Wales (809 NAS). Tracks active and historical maintenance discrepancies (JCN), S1000D / JTD work unit codes (WUC), aircraft readiness status (FMC, PMC-M, NMC-M, NMC-S), MICAP supply holds, technician assignments, and MTTR metrics.

fields.name: work_order_id
fields.description: Primary Key: ODIN / MOD Form 707A Job Control Number (JCN), e.g., WO-2026-88412.

fields.name: tail_number
fields.description: UK Lightning Force aircraft serial number (e.g., ZM151, ZM154). Foreign key to airframe_component_telemetry.tail_number.

fields.name: aircraft_variant
fields.description: F-35 variant (F-35B STOVL for UK Lightning Force).

fields.name: squadron
fields.description: Assigned unit (617 Sqn (The Dambusters), 809 NAS (The Immortals), 207 Sqn (OCU)).

fields.name: base_location
fields.description: Operating location (RAF Marham, HMS Queen Elizabeth, or HMS Prince of Wales).

fields.name: aircraft_status
fields.description: Current readiness condition code: FMC (Full Mission Capable), PMC-M (Partial Mission Capable - Maintenance), NMC-M (Not Mission Capable - Maintenance), or NMC-S (Not Mission Capable - Supply / MICAP).

fields.name: work_order_status
fields.description: Job lifecycle state: OPEN, IN_PROGRESS, AWAITING_PARTS (MICAP), AWAITING_ENGINEERING_DISPOSITION, or COMPLETED.

fields.name: priority
fields.description: Maintenance priority level: PRIORITY_1_RED_X (Grounding safety/MICAP), PRIORITY_2_URGENT (Degrades mission capability), or PRIORITY_3_ROUTINE (Deferred/routine).

fields.name: work_center
fields.description: Responsible maintenance work center: FLIGHT_LINE, STRUCTURES_LO, PROPULSION, AVIONICS, or ARMAMENT.

fields.name: wuc_code
fields.description: S1000D / JTD Work Unit Code (e.g., 27-10 Flight Control Actuator, 53-30 Forward Fuselage Canopy Latch, 53-20 Frame 496 Nacelle Bulkhead).

fields.name: subsystem_name
fields.description: Human-readable aircraft subsystem name corresponding to wuc_code.

fields.name: discrepancy_narrative
fields.description: Pilot or technician reported fault description from ODIN / MOD Form 707A.

fields.name: corrective_action
fields.description: Current maintenance action taken, JTD Data Module referenced, or engineering hold status.

fields.name: awaiting_part_nsn
fields.description: NATO Stock Number (NSN) if work_order_status = 'AWAITING_PARTS (MICAP)' or part replacement is scheduled; NULL otherwise.

fields.name: assigned_shift_lead
fields.description: Ranked UK MOD maintenance supervisor assigned to the job (e.g., Chf Tech M. Davies).

fields.name: estimated_mttr_hours
fields.description: Estimated Mean Time To Repair (hours) based on JTD standard task times.

fields.name: logged_man_hours
fields.description: Cumulative technician man-hours logged against the work order to date.

fields.name: created_at_utc
fields.description: UTC timestamp when the work order was opened in ODIN (DAY partition key).
